description:
Screening check for a person or a company, before you deal with them.
    Returns matches with the programme, designation date and a citation.
    $2.00 per check.
      XRPL   : 2 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $2.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $2.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        name: Person or company name to check (at least 2 characters).
        type: OPTIONAL. "individual" or "entity" to narrow the match.
        country: OPTIONAL. Two-letter country filter.
        limit: OPTIONAL. Maximum results, 1-25, default 10.
name: xrplme_screen
